description.en: An OpenAI-compatible model inference endpoint; free quota and eligibility depend on account verification and current platform policy.
description.zh-Hans: 兼容 OpenAI 接口的模型推理服务，免费额度和资格取决于账号认证及平台当前政策。

detail.en: ModelScope provides hosted inference APIs for models in its community. The OpenAI-compatible endpoint can be connected to ChatSpeed after obtaining an access token, while available models, account eligibility, regional access, and free quota should be confirmed in the current official documentation.
detail.zh-Hans: 魔塔社区为平台中的模型提供托管推理 API。获取访问令牌后，可以通过兼容 OpenAI 的接口接入 ChatSpeed；可用模型、账号资格、区域访问和免费额度应以官方最新文档为准。

provider.name: ModelScope
provider.desc: An OpenAI-compatible model inference service from ModelScope.
